states.label: Labelled phone tab bar on rail colours
states.description: Every phone tab bar cell shows its icon and a fitted label (Roboto 11 px; Medium when current) on the desktop rail's colours, with the current cell full height on the rail's lighter surface under a 3 px green top line (PPO-PHONE-TAB-BAR-DEC, T1-T8). Drawn in the six module Figma files on 10 November 2026; not built yet.

gaps.expected: Every phone tab bar cell shows its icon and the phone label in section 3 of PPO-PHONE-TAB-BAR-DEC, fitting at 320 px without wrapping or truncating, with the label as the accessible name and the current cell full height.
gaps.actual: The application hides phone bar labels visually (src/app/styles/figma-shell.css; src/app/styles/projects-register.css for Projects), and cells outside Sales would show full destination names that do not fit.
gaps.action: Codex builds from the decision once it is merged and Dean has saved the Sales named version; Claude reviews once. Colours stay on the desktop rail's tokens until the refined rail (S2) moves both together.
